_comment: Body tree, joints, couplings and actuators for cartesian_hand_sim. Read only by common/pipeline/build_mjcf.py; unknown keys like this one are ignored. Structure was extracted from the Fusion design on 2026-08-28 and cross-checked with the designer -- see ../README.md for the Fusion-name mapping and the full derivation.
_ranges_note: SIGN CONVENTION (2026-08-29): every joint axis points in its USEFUL direction, so q=0 is the export/rest pose (bridge down, fingers retracted, jaws shut) and POSITIVE q = lift / extend / open; all ranges are [0, travel]. TRAVELS ARE MEASURED ON HARDWARE (2026-09-06), superseding the CAD values: finger 65 mm, bridge_z 52 mm, jaw 52 mm per side. The CAD numbers they replace were finger and bridge_z 60 mm (their Fusion zero) and jaw 52.6317 mm (30 + 22.631707485, the rack drivers parked hard against their upper limit); ../EXPORT_NOTES.md still derives those and is kept as the export's own record, so expect it to disagree with this file. The right_*_y followers derive from their driver via the coupling. Measured on the built hand, so unlike the CAD values these are reachable, but they are still not checked against MuJoCo self-collision.
_force_note: actuator_defaults.forcerange is inherited from the sibling Cartesian Hand (+-87 N, from a pinion radius of 8 mm), NOT derived for this design. This gripper's servo and pinion have not been measured. Re-derive before running any force-sensitive task.
_couplings_note: Two rack pairs. Every jaw axis points OUTWARD (left jaws -Y, right jaws +Y), so the follower simply equals its driver: polycoef [0, 1, ...] means q(right) = q(left) and equal q is a symmetric open. The four *_finger_x joints are deliberately NOT coupled: each finger has its own servo (Fusion Motion Links 28/29 couple them, a CAD mistake confirmed by the designer).
_actuators_note: 7 actuators for 9 joints: the two coupled rack pairs take one each, the four fingers are independent. This matches the 7 FEETECH servos in the CAD one-for-one -- servo 3 drives bridge_z, servo 1 the down pair, servo 2 the up pair, servos 4-7 the four fingers. Gains are inherited from the sibling Cartesian Hand and have not been tuned for this design's masses.
_collision_note: Disabled for the first build: no CoACD pieces exist yet, and a visual-only model is enough to verify the mechanism, the ranges and the two couplings in the viewer. After running decompose_collision.py, set enabled to true and rebuild.
